0a49sxwp.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Brown - 60 cm
0a49sxwp.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Brown - 60 cm
0a49sxwp.sourceDescription: Create the perfect holiday ambience with this wooden Christmas tree! It adds a unique charm and festive atmosphere to your home, office and other places. Rustic and unique charm: This Christmas tree, crafted from natural wood, adds a rustic touch to your living space. Each tree has its unique character, featuring knots, cracks and varied colours that highlight the wood's natural beauty, making it a one-of-a-kind addition to your holiday decor.For DIY design: You can customise it by painting it in various colours and patterns, draping it with string lights, and adding advent calendar bags or colourful decorations to create a festive display.Rotating branches: This wooden Christmas tree features rotating branches that allow users to customize its shape for a more appealing look. Its design also ensures easy storage, making it an ideal choice for small spaces.Exceptional stability: The wide, sturdy base offers excellent stability, minimising the risk of tipping over.Wide applications: This Christmas ornament is a versatile addition to your decor, perfect for any holiday—Christmas, Easter, Valentine's Day, and parties. It's an ideal decoration for homes, weddings, shopping malls, offices, and more, bringing a touch of charm to any occasion. Good to know:The delivery includes the wooden tree only; decorations are not included. Product Specifications Material: Solid pinewood (untreated) Overall dimensions: 40 x 40 x 60 cm (L x W x H) Base size: 30 x 32 cm (L x W) Rotating branches Suitable for indoor use Assembly required: Yes • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

zrt2b0jf.sourceDescription: Christmas made extra fun? Yes please. Do it, this season and beyond, with this Outsunny inflatable Christmas crystal ball, with Santa and a reindeer and Xmas tree inside, a world full of snow. The polyester shell makes this a tough piece, which is also IP44 rated for mild water resistance - it's suitable for use in mild rain outdoors. Inside there are five white LED lights - this blow up Christmas decoration glows and sparkles to bring the night alive, this season and beyond. ● Fun design for Christmas: Santa Claus, reindeer and Xmas tree snow globe ● Inner white LED lights to glow at night ● Plug into the mains to inflate and set up. Turn off to deflate, with a bag for storage ● IP44 rated polyester shell is safe in mild rain. Broken glass or sharp edges may cause injury. Place or install securely and stop using if damaged.
